best_for: Kids aged 10-15 ready for typed code
Students wanting to learn a 'real' programming language
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Graduates of Scratch Programming will find this transition natural.

prerequisites.required: Basic typing skills and familiarity with saving files.

system_requirements.software_accounts: Web browser (for Replit) or local installation of Mu Editor.

overview.positioning: A fun, accessible introduction to one of the world's most popular programming languages.
overview.short_description: Learn to write real code with Python! Create digital art with Turtle graphics, build fun text-based games, and learn the logic behind professional software.

key_facts.capstone: A Custom Python Arcade or Quiz Game
key_facts.ai_integration: Low - Focuses on syntax and logic

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Create colorful geometric art using Turtle graphics
Build interactive quiz programs and number guessing games

why_now.industry_shift: Python is the leading language for AI and data, making it highly relevant.
why_now.ai_impact: Understanding Python is the first step toward understanding AI.
why_now.business_demand: Python skills are universally sought after in tech.
why_now.career_opportunity: Gives students a massive head start in computer science.

learning_outcomes: TYPE: Write clean, syntactically correct Python code.
DRAW: Program visual graphics using the Turtle library.
LOGIC: Implement conditionals and loops to solve problems.

stages.focus: Using Turtle to make code visual and fun.
Using loops and functions to build games.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Syntax, data types, and logic structures

stages.name: Testing
stages.desc: Running the code to see the output.

ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Instructors to help with indentation errors.

best_practices: Watch your indentation! Python relies on spaces to group code.
Use comments (#) to explain what your code does.
Don't forget the colon (:) at the end of if statements and loops.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Mixing spaces and tabs, or forgetting to indent after a colon.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Always use the Tab key uniformly and check alignment.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Usually a missing parenthesis or quotation mark.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Check the line above the error to ensure all brackets are closed.

freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: A Replit portfolio of working code.

final_deliverables: A functional, interactive Python game or art project.

assessment.criteria: Code runs without syntax errors and achieves the desired output.

faq.question: Do I need to install Python?
faq.answer: We recommend using a web-based editor like Replit so no installation is needed, but we also show how to install Mu Editor if you prefer.

faq.question: Is this real Python?
faq.answer: Yes! It is the exact same Python language used by professionals at Google and NASA, just taught in a fun, kid-friendly way.

lessons.expected_outcome: A script that prints variable data.

lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a Mad Libs word game.

Uses loops to draw complex stars and circles.

lessons.what_learner_does: Generates a beautiful, complex spirograph pattern.

modules.hands_on_practice: Design a custom piece of Turtle art.

modules.module_purpose: Learn conditionals and functions to build interactive games.

lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a trivia quiz using functions for each question.
